# Design Agents Toolkit reference originals

This folder retains useful original Markdown from the user's supplied
`design-agents-toolkit-dss.zip`, credited in its footers to
[designsystems.surf](https://designsystems.surf).

Start with [Forma's setup and usage guide](../../docs/toolkit-setup.md).

`originals/` contains unmodified source files. These examples are references,
not automatically installed skills or new project instructions. Forma's actual
workflow remains in `AGENTS.md` and `docs/design-system-maintenance.md`.

`inventory.json` inventories every archive entry, including the PDFs and macOS
metadata not extracted here. It records byte counts, SHA-256 hashes, original
paths and extraction decisions. The archive itself is unchanged. Original PDFs
remain in the supplied archive; this setup does not claim a visual review of them.

No separate license file was present in the archive. Original attribution
footers are preserved; this folder does not assert a new license or permission
to republish the toolkit. No scripts or executables were installed or run.
